method: Local read-only PSARC logical payload comparison using asset_pipeline.psarc.parse_psarc and iter_entry; SHA-256 of every payload in manifest order.
ledger_encoding: For each payload in manifest order append UTF-8 path, NUL, decimal logical size, NUL, and binary SHA-256 digest; hash the concatenated bytes.
qualification: This proves equal live payloads in the two identified local archives. The coordinating agent is independently verifying the remote archive SHA-256; remote SIZE alone is not an identity check.
local_writes: This evidence file only; source archives were read without extraction to disk or rebuilding.
